newsitem.title: POLAND: Girl quadruplets born to Polish couple.
newsitem.headline: Girl quadruplets born to Polish couple.

text.p: Quadruplet girls were born on Wednesday to a Polish couple in the western port city of Szczecin, PAP news agency said.
PAP quoted Krystyna Lange-Konior, the head of the obstetrics ward at Szczecin medical school clinic, as saying the mother did not undergo any fertility treatment, often the cause of multiple births.
"Such a miracle happens once in 12 million births," said Lange-Konior.
She said the infants were delivered by Caesarean section in the 36th week of pregnancy and both the mother and the four girls, weighing between one kg and 2.12 kg, were in good condition.
The mother Jolanta Poplawska, 33, runs a small shop near Szczecin, and the father Janusz has a farm. The couple have two other daughters and a son.
